meta.title: 9-Day Nordic Summer Escape | NordisTravel
meta.description: Embark on an extraordinary 9-day summer journey through Sweden, Norway, and Denmark. Discover Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, the Flåm Railway, and majestic fjords on a premium, curated Scandinavian vacation.

hero.subtitle: Fjords, Castles & Capitals:
hero.title: The Ultimate 9-Day Nordic Escape
hero.description: Discover the magic of Sweden, Norway, and Denmark on a premium, curated journey through Scandinavia’s most iconic landscapes and vibrant historic capitals.

map_deck.title: THE MAP DECK
map_deck.description: Visualize your premium journey across Scandinavia’s scenic routes, mountains, and seas.

steps.title: Sweden Entrance
steps.description: Start in Stockholm, the Venice of the North. Cruise historical canals and unwind by the lake in Karlstad.

steps.title: Norway Fjordlands
steps.description: Cross into Norway. Explore Oslo's art parks, ski summits, and take the breathtaking Flåm Mountain Railway loop.

steps.title: Denmark Coast & Castles
steps.description: Sail overnight to Copenhagen. Immerse yourself in Tivoli, Danish Smørrebrød, and Shakespeare's Elsinore Castle.

itinerary.title: The Journey Begins
itinerary.vibe_text: Leave the ordinary behind. Board your flight and prepare to wake up in the capital of Nordic chic.

highlights.title: Flight Departure
highlights.description: Depart your flight bound for Stockholm Arlanda Airport. Smooth boarding and flight preparations.

itinerary.title: Royalty, Canals & Historic Cobblestone
itinerary.tagline: 🇸🇪 Stockholm to Karlstad: The Swedish Transition
itinerary.vibe_text: Explore a city built across 14 islands before winding down by the scenic shores of Lake Vänern.

highlights.title: Stockholm City Tour
highlights.description: Wander the medieval alleyways of Gamla Stan (Old Town), view the Royal Palace, the grand Opera House, and catch panoramic views from Fjällgatan Hill.

highlights.title: Scenic Countryside Drive
highlights.description: Relax on a panoramic 2.5-hour coach ride (225 km) deep into the Swedish countryside to Karlstad.

highlights.title: Welcome Dinner
highlights.description: Regroup for an authentic dinner at a local Karlstad restaurant.

images.alt: Peaceful lake and nature in Karlstad

itinerary.title: Sculpture Parks & Majestic Fjords
itinerary.tagline: 🇳🇴 Crossing Borders: Karlstad to Oslo & Ål
itinerary.vibe_text: Transition from Sweden to Norway. Experience masterfully crafted art parks before heading into the gateway of the majestic Norwegian fjords.

highlights.title: Oslo City Tour
highlights.description: Walk among the 200+ mesmerizing masterworks in Vigeland Sculpture Park and Frogner Park, stand outside the Oslo Cathedral, and feel the energy of Karl Johans gate.

highlights.title: Holmenkollen Panoramic View
highlights.description: Capture a panoramic snapshot at the world-famous Holmenkollen ski jump area overlooking the city and fjords.

highlights.title: Into the Highlands
highlights.description: Board your long-distance coach for a scenic 3-hour journey (195 km) to the mountain village of Ål.

highlights.title: Alpine Feast
highlights.description: Indulge in a premium 3-course or buffet dinner hosted at your hotel.

images.alt: Vigeland Sculpture Park monolith granite statues
Scenic road winding into green mountain highlands

itinerary.title: The Crown Jewel of Rail Journeys
itinerary.vibe_text: Prepare for one of the absolute highlights of your trip—a jaw-dropping train ride through steep ravines, cascading waterfalls, and deep fjords.

highlights.title: The Legendary Flåm Railway
highlights.description: Board the legendary Flåm-Myrdal loop. Peer out panoramic windows as you ascend over 800 meters along the sheer walls of the valley.

highlights.title: Fjord-Side Lunch
highlights.description: Savor local specialties at a charming local restaurant in the heart of the valley.

highlights.title: Highland Return
highlights.description: Return to the serene comfort of Ål for another incredible 3-course hotel dinner.

slides.alt: Vintage green Flåm railway train alongside cliff
slides.title: The Flåm Railway
slides.caption: Ascend steep mountain cliffs passing roaring waterfalls.

slides.alt: Spectacular green mountain valley in Flåm
slides.title: Flåm Valley Fjord View
slides.caption: Verdant green peaks meeting crystal waters.

itinerary.title: Setting Sail on the Baltic Sea
itinerary.tagline: 🚢 Oslo to Copenhagen: The Overnight Luxury Cruise
itinerary.vibe_text: Say goodbye to Norway's mountains with a grand farewell tour of Oslo, then step aboard a premium cruise liner to sleep your way across the sea to Denmark.

highlights.title: Oslo Farewell & Palace
highlights.description: See the Parliament building and enjoy a photo stop outside the elegant Royal Palace.

highlights.title: Go Nordic Cruiseline Cabin
highlights.description: Check into your private, comfortable overnight ocean cruise cabin.

highlights.title: The Grand Buffet
highlights.description: Celebrate the evening with a massive, premium dinner buffet on board as you cruise down the historic Oslofjord.

itinerary.stay: 🏨 Stay: Overnight Cruise Inside Cabin (Go Nordic Cruiseline)

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Capital of "Hygge"
itinerary.vibe_text: Wake up in Denmark! Disembark directly into the heart of Copenhagen for a day of absolute freedom to explore at your own pace.

highlights.title: Copenhagen Terminal Arrival
highlights.description: Cruise into the Copenhagen Terminal and check into your downtown boutique hotel.

highlights.title: Free at Leisure
highlights.description: Rent a bike, grab a coffee, stroll down the famous Strøget shopping street, or sit by the colorful townhouses along the canals of Nyhavn.

itinerary.stay: 🏨 Stay: Good Morning City Copenhagen Star (or similar)

images.alt: Vibrant townhouses along the canal in Nyhavn
Tivoli Gardens illuminated at night with lights

itinerary.title: Of Castles, Queens & Open Sandwiches
itinerary.vibe_text: Dive deep into Danish history, indulge in world-class local cuisine, and explore the legendary seaside fortress that inspired Hamlet.

highlights.title: Copenhagen City Highlights
highlights.description: Visit the mystical Little Mermaid statue, Gefion Fountain, Amalienborg Palace, and the majestic Frederiks Kirke (The Marble Church).

highlights.title: The Smørrebrød Experience
highlights.description: Sit down for an authentic Danish lunch to try world-famous, beautifully arranged open-faced sandwiches.

highlights.title: Elsinore Castle (Kronborg)
highlights.description: Travel north to Elsinore to stand in the real-life coastal fortress made immortal by William Shakespeare's Hamlet.

itinerary.stay: 🏨 Stay: Good Morning City Copenhagen Star (or similar)

items.title: The Little Mermaid

itinerary.title: Farewell Scandinavia
itinerary.vibe_text: Savor your final morning of fresh Danish pastries and coffee before heading to the airport for your smooth journey home.

highlights.title: Leisurely Breakfast & Souvenirs
highlights.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel followed by last-minute souvenir hunting and boutique exploring at leisure.

highlights.title: Hassle-Free Airport Transfer
highlights.description: Comfortable group airport transfer pickup timed perfectly with your departure flight.

highlights.title: Return Arrival (Day 9)
highlights.description: Arrive back at your destination airport with a lifetime of spectacular Nordic memories.

media.alt: Sleek, minimalist architecture layout of Copenhagen airport

parallax_sections.title: Cruise Across The Skagerrak
parallax_sections.subtitle: Dine, relax, and wake up in Copenhagen.

booking.title: Secure Your Nordic Summer Escape
booking.description: Book your summer adventure today. Our premium package includes scenic transportation, luxury rail passes, overnight fjord cruise, hotel stays, and professional tour leadership.

value_insights.title: VALUE INSIGHTS
value_insights.description: Premium value and total transparency. Here is exactly what is included in your tour.
inclusions: Overnight Stays: 6 nights in premium standard rooms (Good Morning Karlstad, Thon Hotel Hallingdal, Good Morning City Copenhagen Star) plus 1 night in a cruise cabin.
Premium Meals: 7 breakfasts on-board/hotels, 1 Danish Smørrebrød lunch, 1 buffet dinner on-board the cruise, and 2 alpine dinners in Ål.
Scenic Transits: Long-distance coach services across Sweden and Norway.
Activities & Passes: Flåm Railway return loop ticket, Oslo & Stockholm panoramic city tours, Kronborg Castle entry excursion.
exclusions: Personal shopping, custom souvenirs, and optional local activities.
Lunches and dinners not explicitly detailed in the itinerary.
Entry tickets to sites not specified under inclusions.

footer.description: Providing premium, authentic travel experiences across the spectacular landscapes of Scandinavia. Our team organizes every detail so you can focus on making memories that last a lifetime.
